newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI AT NEW HIGHS WITH NOKIA AT 400 MARKKA.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI AT NEW HIGHS WITH NOKIA AT 400 MARKKA.

text.p: * HEX and FOX indices hit new highs in moderate trade on Friday
with Nokia at 400 markka and Merita at 20 markka records. Strong
sentiment overseas helps. Metals strong with Konecranes and
Rautaruukki in the lead.
Shares scaled new highs on the
main indices in fair trade at midsession on Friday, with Nokia
hitting 400.00 markka for the first time ever and with the
general outlook firm amid strong overseas tone, brokers say.
"This looks strong," one broker said, with the FOX index up
about 0.7 percent.
Nokia traded up 4.50 markka at 400.00 after testing an
all-time intrasession high of 401.00 in moderate 54 million
markka trade. Its gains boosted the FOX by 2.5 points.
While some brokers saw scope for further gains in Nokia,
others said the 400.00 level was triggering selling.
Besides a strong overnight performance on Wall St, brokers
said sentiment towards Nokia was helped by news this week that
German media group Kirsch was progressing in plans to develop
digital television, for which Nokia supplies decoder boxes.
Raisio, up 13.00 markka at 387.00, was also significant in
the index rise, accounting for just over one point in FOX gains.
Merita was lively as overseas demand took it to a year-high
20.20 markka at one stage, but it later fell back to an
unchanged 19.90. The only negatives in the FOX index were Orion,
Cultor and Sampo, which together shaved just off under half a
point. --Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 235, news@reuters.fi
